source.label: CY-Bench centroids.zip (Zenodo)
source.method: centroid point of every administrative unit in the per-country centroid shapefiles (adm_id), EPSG:4326

note: 11,432 administrative units in 43 countries (largest: BR 5572, US 3233, IN 585, AR 526, DE 401); 3,000 units stored. Maize and wheat yield series are per unit-year (BR shapefile has no CRS and is taken as WGS84).
